findings.reason: Real TS5.9.3/TS6.0.3 projects check exact classes, fields, constructor parameter properties, inherited extras, object exports, private/protected/#private helpers and separate statics. Binding tests reject whitespace/comma lists, repeated tags and multiple direct implementations at independently computed locations, including check/gate exit codes. Inheritance composes callable members and overloads through one derived contract, with changed arity/extra members as negative controls. Local named export tests enforce coverage and retain type-only/imported/default exemptions.

Compiler-backed direct/local-export fixtures compare exact independently located diagnostics, require/warn/off policy and CLI exit codes. TS5/TS6 cases retain type-only/default/imported exemptions and reject class/function/object/opaque-const gaps. Scalar literal/expression controls pass, assertions cannot disguise functions, explicit invalid bindings remain errors, ignored files and nearest-module ownership are exercised, and exempt scalar changes still invalidate consumer review fingerprints.

Compiler-backed positive/negative cases distinguish parameter count, optional/default/rest, null acceptance, narrowed inputs/results, nested callbacks, readonly/optional fields, setter input domains and opaque/open surfaces. TS5/TS6 regressions now pass for intersection setters, mapped intersection fields, renamed generic conditional callbacks and labelled tuples. Conditional tests independently call the shape checker to avoid relying only on TS assignability. Primitive setter intersections retain per-constituent substitutions and are checked against actual compiler assignment diagnostics. Argument-independent recursive types pass; changed leaves/modifiers/argument-dependent shapes reject or fail explicitly, with comparison limits reset before the next check. Audit regressions distinguish declared generic/infer constraints (including nested callbacks), deferred keyof/indexed/template operators under substitutions, exact-optional tuple markers and inherited mapped setters. Independent compiler probes establish both equivalent cases and drift controls; unsupported operator instantiation remains explicit, never accepted by object identity. Shared-package mapped instances retain undefined in type arguments and exact-optional property markers; equivalent no-declaration mapped fields are compared instead of rejected. TS5/TS6 synthetic library fixtures and installed-package E2E exercise real Zod inheritance without type assertions, with wrong schema and surplus API rejected. The new recovery rules have mutation controls; unresolved generic growth remains an explicit error. The new cause analysis runs only after a mismatch and leaves the comparator unchanged; grouping regressions assert raw outcomes and mixed mismatches remain errors.

findings.reason: TS5/TS6 projects cover local/imported data and contract bases, resolved member modifiers and origins, inherited test linkage, diamonds, conflicting invariant IDs, incompatible bases/redeclarations and cycles. CLI lock tests reject changed/removed inherited signatures/invariants and permit only extendable additions; generic substitutions and overloads are retained. Review mutations of local/imported bases invalidate the derived contract while an unrelated contract stays current; packet assertions expose inherited origins. Rich inherited call/member/generic/overloaded APIs have positive controls and structural drift mutations. Alias and mapped-type regressions reject copied contract members whose promises would disappear, follow imported and transparent generic aliases, and require explicit errors for unresolved origins. Composition, dead conditional branches and unselected copied fields are positive controls; extending the original contract restores its invariant and removing the derived test produces E_TEST_MISSING.

Compiler-backed TS5/TS6 cases reject broken selected declarations while honoring effective suppression and leaving unrelated invalid declarations outside the check. Alias, workspace, ambient, computed-key, global and augmentation cases inspect the selected dependency files; a linked CLI mutation test records review and final lock, changes only each of merged, computed-key and global contributor declarations, and requires both stale review and lock violation with changed material visible. Entry and internal route retargeting, duplicate versions and physical-copy swaps have positive and negative fingerprint controls, while source-only and unreadable dependencies are rejected. Module value queries are checked through both import syntaxes with paired value/type-only routes, export-equals and import-equals aliases, nested namespaces and destructured type annotations. Same-file ambient modules distinguish the owning module. Independent TS5/TS6 diagnostic probes confirmed the former false-green cases now fail and type-only star exports stay outside the selected value surface.

Node and Vitest fixtures retain explicit skip/todo links, including suite inheritance and options, without inactive-test errors. Independent expectations reject an invariant with no test, reject unmarked empty callbacks and broken imports, and warn for an empty declaration beside either an active or explicitly skipped declaration. CLI counts distinguish linked from active declarations/invariants and keep executedTests null. Nothing runs or mocks a project test to establish those counts.

CLI cases assert 2 for usage/configuration/environment failures, 1 for rule violations and 0 for warnings-only results; structured counts and actual stdout/stderr are checked. New structural errors also assert check=1 and gate=2.

Existing exact output tests retain standalone diagnostic formatting and indentation. New compiler-backed cases compare complete grouped headings and independently located member/contract rows, with one shared explanation and no repeated per-row prose. When no useful summary can be established the original full diagnostic is preserved. JSON retains each message and related location.

Real CLI projects on both compiler versions assert every original violation, severity, independently located member and contract, plus exact shared-cause rows for PageHandle, same-spelled Band aliases and inherited library members. Distinct same-spelled declarations, multiple mismatches, naked primitive/tuple mismatches and clipped-away differences stay separate. The text summary reveals resolved alias types; full JSON messages remain intact. Check and hook commands retain failing exit codes and total violation counts, and review blockers remain separate. An inherited static surface without its own contract keeps the explicit missing-static-contract explanation instead of a misleading shared-cause row with no affected contract.

Compiler-backed CLI cases compute independent expected priority/group selection for limits 0, 1, 3, 9 and 50, assert every shown subject and omitted count by code, and keep full error/warning totals. JSON still limits individual violations. Gate limits only blocker groups and keeps the full blocker total. Serialized whole and raw-limited reports format identically to their in-memory equivalents, so formatting does not depend on hidden object history.

Grouping tests assert connected shared changes, additional private changes, deterministic order and separate missing/unknown entries, with no packets for current/accepted entries. CLI tests assert executable commands, statuses, touched invariants and visible malformed-record errors.

CLI and formatter tests compare independently selected source ranges, changed/all/none/context modes, unchanged full findings and suggestions, and separate contract fingerprints. Compact-output tests reconstruct every source block and test link, distinguish identical titles at different locations and assert one schema example. Shared and overlapping excerpts retain their exact union without mutating JSON.

Tests mutate one linked test, evidence-cited tests, coverage links and non-test material, then assert exact touched sets. Reordered material with unchanged per-part digests takes the conservative all-invariants fallback; output mode must not change attribution.

Bounded import-chain tests assert no scope-limit diagnostics in check, index or packets under warn and require. Linked gate tests exclude them from blocked and released feedback. Symlink cases assert the outside sentinel is never loaded under either review policy; chmod-based in-scope failures require E_ENVIRONMENT, incomplete packets, refusal to record and byte-identical existing records.

Actual recording commands reject stale fingerprints, unknown contracts/invariants, missing assessments, duplicate entries and blank reasons/evidence. Mixed valid/invalid submissions record nothing; unreadable in-scope dependencies also preserve the existing record bytes.

Mutation tests change contract prose, code, assertions, suite setup and selected dependencies, then assert the recorded review becomes stale with the changed part named. Package tests mutate merged/global contributors and retarget entry or dependency edges without changing declaration text, requiring stale review and changed material in the packet; irrelevant package edits stay current.

The tests compare fingerprints before and after inert comments and spacing, then change syntax, literal contents and directive placement to show that meaningful edits stale the review. Package declaration tests similarly keep ordinary formatting inert while retaining compiler directives and reference directives in declaration digests.

CLI cases construct legacy and code-v1 records and assert unchanged bytes/current status until relevant edits. Old fingerprints cannot be resubmitted for new material; fresh recording switches to code-v2 and only then ignores independent object members and ordinary code comments.

TS 5/6 and CLI mutation cases change selected fields/methods, sibling calls, helpers and shared mutable captures and require fingerprint changes/stale reviews. Cached selection tests compare exact selected declarations, connecting imports and distinct same-spelled relative targets; nested mutators cannot disappear.

Negative controls alter only independent declarations/methods and assert identical fingerprints/current records. Parameter and local-binding cases ensure they do not select the whole receiver. Multi-root caching tests prove private imports stay separate and reverse root order preserves the corresponding material.

Cases with getters, spreads, dynamic/whole-object uses, shared nested state, uncertain captures and observable initialization require whole-object/file retention. Changes to unrelated content then invalidate the fingerprint. Compiler-matrix boundary cases cover cycles and opaque syntax rather than assuming purity.

CLI scenarios inspect acceptance flags, empty findings, separate accepted/reviewed counts and gate behavior. Repeating acceptance keeps bytes stable; mutations invalidate only affected material, and renewal retains current verdicts independently.

Real CLI/hook inputs assert required missing/stale/weak reviews and ordinary errors block, while warn-policy findings do not. Mixed diagnostics stay filtered on initial blocks and after the session limit; success resets the session count. Shared-cause fixtures additionally assert grouped feedback still exits 2 and counts every structural blocker while preserving separate review blocks.

Real lock records reject edits to final or existing extendable members, including inherited mapped modifiers, while base comparison catches deletion from the lock file. Package lock tests mutate transitive and merged/global contributor declarations and retarget route edges with identical declaration sets; both dependency versions and same-version physical copies remain distinct, and a pure package-version update leaves the lock intact.

CLI output is asserted equal to the legend formatter with exactly one line per emitted code and correct option handling. The separately linked legend invariant checks the source and documentation in both directions, including the conformance and duplicate-implementation diagnostics.

Tests preserve existing configuration, edited instructions/skills and unrelated hooks, then assert repeated initialization is stable. Generated hooks run with shell-sensitive paths and must pass exact arguments without creating injection markers; TOML must decode correctly.

The linked test scans emitted diagnostic literals, compares the resulting set with CODES in both directions, checks every reference-table row, and verifies one formatted meaning/action line per code. An omitted or extra diagnostic code fails the test.

The tests compare the complete no-file result with defaultConfig, then provide only selected fields and assert all other defaults remain. A depth-only reviewDependencies value must retain maxFiles and exclude defaults.

The test supplies malformed JSON, invalid top-level objects, wrong field types and unknown fields, asserting E_CONFIG for each problem and an unchanged complete default configuration even when valid and invalid fields are mixed.
